llm_response.reason: The website has existed since 2002 with consistent domain activity and references well-known brands in its niche (Steiff, Hermann, Kosen). Content focuses on selling plush toys with industry-standard payment and shipping practices, no unrealistic claims or manipulative text, and standard privacy policies. Contact methods (email and FAX) are not unusual for Japanese online shops. While the SSL certificate has issues and the copyright is not fully up to date, these are insufficient to reach a scam determination. No evidence of mimicked brands, fake endorsements, urgency tactics, or unrealistic returns was found.
